It consisted of a number of handwritten and printed slips with slogans urging the people to support the war of resistance.

The slips together with translation are attached hereto.

The pro-Nanking Government elements observed the anniversary with posters bearing slogans of a pro-Wang Ching Wei nature being posted in the Western District, O.O.L., Nantao, Pootung and Chapei. No demonstrations were conducted.

The iron gates along the boundary between Nantao and French Concession were closed on July 7, but free passage was allowed for a short interval of two hours from 5 a.m. to 7 a.m. The gates were re-opened at 1 a.m. July 8.

Two male Chinese were arrested, one by the Municipal Police on July 6 and the other by the French Police on July 4, for distributing handbills of a national salvation nature on the occasion of the July 7th Anniversary.

1941年7月7日是卢沟桥事变（1937年）爆发四周年纪念日，该日平静度过，未发生任何意外事件。7月4日至7日期间，在租界各区及法租界内，秘密散发少量具有救国、抗日及反汪精卫性质的宣传文献。这些文献包括一些手写和印刷的纸条，上面印有呼吁民众支持抗战的标语。

「七七」四周年紀念全市告青年書

親愛的青年們！
今天是七七四周年紀念日，也就是中華民族決心爭取獨立自由生存，決心忍受任何犧牲，決心發動長期神聖抗戰的紀念日。在這神聖的抗戰臨到最後勝利的前夕，逢到這偉大的日子，我們回顧四年來苦鬥的痕跡，瞻望光明的前途，真值得我們無限的興奮！勝利的曙光已見，建國的基礎已經確立，但我們應該深切的認識：目前正是我們最艱辛的一個階段；尤其在此時此地的孤島，我們必須以更大的勇氣，更進一步的刻苦自勵，加緊時刻，堅持到底！全上海同胞至上民族至上意志集中力量集中的信條，再接再厲，加倍努力向着光明的神聖抗建大道邁進，爭取最後勝利，完成民族解放的使命。
四年以前，一九三七年即民國廿六年七月七日，深入我國河北省的敵人，突向駐防盧溝橋的我們駐軍挑釁，並向北平天津兩地，多方壓迫，企圖實現日本帝國主義者的無底野心！我們為了民族的生存，國家的獨立，於是燃起了正義的火炬，激起了神聖的抗戰，捨身頭顱熱血，不惜任何犧牲，與暴敵周旋，到現在已整整四年，今天正是第五年的開始。
在這四年中，中華民族已顯示了無比的威力，已得到了相當的收穫。我們所有物質上精神上的一切犧牲和損失，已為國家換得了更多的代價。到今天「七七」抗戰四周年的時候，我們軍事形勢，已勝券在握；政治形勢，光輝燦爛；經濟形勢，異常充沛；國際形勢，更日趨有利；這一切，都是最後勝利的有力保證。同時衆志成城，愈戰愈堅固，將士忠勇衛國，全國民衆一心一德，空軍效力，使敵人的陰謀破產，給予無限的同仇與援助。所以我們今天正可以格外堅定我們抗戰必勝建國必成的信念。

July 7th and July 9th Anniversaries

There is no indication that local radical
elements will carry out organized propaganda
campaigns and/or demonstrations on July 7, the
anniversary of the outbreak of Sino-Japanese
hostilities in 1937, or on July 9, the anniversary
of the commencement of the Anti-Northern Expedition
in 1926.

Schools have closed for the summer vacation
and no meetings of a political nature will be held
by students, while commercial and industrial organs
have no intention of conducting any activities in
commemoration of the anniversaries.

However, surreptitious dissemination of
national salvation literature bearing on the
July 7th anniversary has commenced in the International
Settlement and French Concession. Publication
in the Chinese press of articles in support of
either the Chungking or the Nanking Government
is expected.

The Nanking Government authorities are
holding a propaganda week from July 1 to July 7.
In Shanghai, their activities are confined to
the distribution of pro-Peace and anti-Comintern
literature in the Japanese occupied area and

S. 1. Special Branch Station / File No. Date July 3, 1941.

SUBJECT: Events to be held during the July 7 Anniversary Commemoration Week

In compliance with the policy of the Japanese Government, the period between July 1 and 7 will be regarded as the Commemoration Week of the Fourth July 7 Anniversary and the following events will be held during the period:-

1.- Hoisting of national flags
During the Commemoration Week, a national flag should be hoisted at the house of every Japanese resident. Students will hoist the flags, but in case there are no such students in a family, the family head himself will hoist the flag.

During the Commemoration Week, radio broadcasts will be made in accordance with the programme compiled by the Shanghai Broadcasting Station.

July 7th Anniversary - Possible observance

Local schools have closed for the summer
vacation and no meetings of a political nature will be held
by students. Local commercial and industrial organs have
no intention of conducting any activities in commemoration
of the anniversary.

There is at present no indication as to possible
activities on the part of local women's organizations on
this anniversary.

In compliance with the measures drawn up by
the Nanking Government, the Shanghai Special Municipal
Government has designated the period from July 1 to July 7
as the "Peace, Anti-Comintern and National Reconstruction
Week". During this week, slogans of a peace and anti-
comintern nature will be posted in Nantao, Chapei,
Pootung and other districts, while in addition the various
high officials of the Nanking Government and of the
Shanghai Special Municipal Government will go on the air
and broadcast speeches propagating the significance of
peace, anti-comintern and national reconstruction.

Surreptitious dissemination of national salvation
literature may, however, be expected prior to and on the
occasion of the anniversary.

To-day, July 7, is the 4th anniversary of the
Lukouchiao Incident. People who love peace and hate
violence will commemorate the event ardently on this day.
Although the situation between China and Japan was
already very bad four years ago, the Chinese authorities, from
the beginning to the end, did their best to improve the
situation in view of the fact that the time for final sacri-
fice had not yet come. This was known to the world. How-
ever, owing to the heavy pressure, China could no longer be
patient and replied to the attack upon Lukouchiao by the
Japanese on July 7 for her liberty and existence and for
the sake of her people.
During the past four years, China has been under
the direction of the supreme command; she has not boasted of
any of her victories, nor has she been discouraged by any
defeat. She is firmly determined and the morale of her
soldiers is very high. She is becoming stronger and the date
of victory is getting nearer day by day.
On the 4th anniversary of the July 7 Incident this
year, people of the friendly nations will commemorate the
event. Great Britain has decided to hold an extensive
propaganda to aid China from the eve of July 7 and to raise
contributions amounting to £1,000 from people of various
circles and to remit the money to China on July 7.
In addition, Britain regards the day as the starting
point for the movement to aid China.
In the meantime, several hundreds of thousands
of propaganda booklets entitled "Four Years of Resistance-
Reconstruction" will be published in England, in which
the special progress that has taken place during the period

热爱和平、憎恶暴力的人们将在这一天热烈纪念

July 2, 1941. Morning Translation.

National Herald, Chinese-American Daily, Sin Wan Pao and
Shun Pao :-

ASSASSINATION OF AN INTERPRETER OF JAPANESE GENDARMERIE

Lee Kyi-kying ( 李 基 慶 ), age 36,
native of Shanghai, who works with the Ministry of
Interior of the Nanking Government and who is concurrently
an interpreter attached to the Japanese gendarmerie, resides
at No. 15 East Sin Loh Tseng alleyway ( 東 新 樂 邨 )
North Kiangse Road.
At about 8.30 a.m. yesterday, whilst
coming out from the East Sin Loh Tseng alleyway, he was
attacked by a youth who fired three shots at him. He
was wounded in the chest and the abdomen and succumbed
to his wounds soon afterwards. The youth made good
his escape.
On receiving information, West
Hongkew Police Station detailed a party of detectives
and policemen to the scene to make an investigation.
The body has been removed to the mortuary. Cartridge
shells were picked up on the spot and taken to the
Station for examination. An investigation is being
conducted by the Police.

Shun Pao, Sin Wan Pao and Chinese-American Daily News :-

ANNIVERSARY OF THE JULY 7 INCIDENT

The fourth anniversary of the July 7
incident is fast approaching. Owing to the special
circumstances prevailing in Shanghai, the people in
various walks of life in this city will commemorate
the sacred resistance-reconstruction day in a spiritual
manner.
In order to maintain peace and good
order, the Police authorities of the International
Settlement and the French Concession will adopt joint
precautionary measures on that day. All meetings and
processions will be prohibited and curfew will be
strictly enforced. During the period, more detectives
and policemen will be detailed to public places for
patrol. Pedestrians and vehicles will be searched.

Kuo Min Daily News, Central China Daily News, Ping Pao and
New China Daily News :-

FIGHT BETWEEN WORKERS OF BUTTERFIELD & SWIRE WHARF

Recently the Butterfield & Swire
Company dismissed a large number of workers engaged in
the transporting of goods and in loading and unloading
cargo on wharves. The Company later recruited a
number of new workers.

日本宪兵队翻译遇刺案

李基庆，36岁，上海人，任职于南京政府内政部，并兼任日本宪兵队翻译，住江西北路东新乐邨15号。昨日上午8时30分许，当其从东新乐邨走出时，遭一名青年袭击，该青年向其连开三枪。李胸部及腹部中弹，随后因伤重不治身亡。该行凶青年已逃脱。

接报后，虹口西区警察局派遣一组侦探及警员赶赴现场进行调查。尸体已被移送至停尸房。现场拾获弹壳，并已送交警局检验。警方正在进行调查。

《申报》、《申晚报》及《中美日报》：

七七事变周年纪念日

七七事变四周年纪念日即将来临。鉴于上海目前的特殊局势，本市各界人士将以精神层面的方式纪念这一神圣的抗战建国日。

为维护和平与良好秩序，公共租界及法租界警务当局将于当日采取联合预防措施。禁止一切集会及游行，并严格执行宵禁。在此期间，将增派侦探及警员前往公共场所巡逻。行人及车辆将接受搜查。

《国民日报》、《华中日报》、《平报》及《新中国日报》：

July 2, 1941. Morning Translation.

National Herald, Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao, Chinese-American
Daily News :-

KIDNAPPING OF DR. ZEE LIANG-TUNG

At 10.35 a.m. July 1, Dr. Zee Liang-tung
(徐樑棟), manager of the Dah Han Chemical Works
(大漢化學藥廠) at No. 18 Route Ferguson, whilst on his
way to attend a call at a certain address on Yenping Road
in his private motor car, licence No. 7340, was stopped
near the International Funeral Directors on Kiaochow
Road by four men, two of whom kept a watch on Dr. Zee
while the other two forced the chauffeur Tsai An-s (蔡安士)
to alight at the point of pistols. As the engine of
the motor car suddenly got out of order, the desperadoes
forced the doctor into a waiting car, licence No. 17740,
of the Ziang Tai Garage (祥泰車行) which was hired at
8 p.m. June 30 by the desperadoes who falsely stated
that they required the car to go to a place near the
International Funeral Directors for the purpose of
conveying a sick person to a doctor's office.
Dr. Zee's family and the chauffeur have
made a report of the occurrence to Bubbling Well Police
Station and an investigation has been started.
Another report states that the car was
found on Avenue Foch west of Yates Road at about 12.20 p.m.
yesterday. The garage was informed by the Police
Station to remove the car.

National Herald, Chinese-American Daily News, Shun Pao,
Sin Wan Pao :-

UNKNOWN MAN ASSASSINATED ON KIANGSE ROAD

At 9.50 p.m. yesterday, a man of about
30 years of age, wearing a long gown, whilst walking
in front of the Mei Ya (美雅) Women's Shoes Shop
at No. 235 Kiangse Road, was fatally shot from behind
by a man wearing a jacket. The gunman made good his
escape. The body was later removed to the mortuary.
Wong Chin-sze (王金氏), age 43, native
of Ningpo, residing in the Dah Tung (大東) hemp
bags shop on Swatow Road, who was riding in a ricksha
from south to north, was wounded in the right leg by
a stray bullet. She was sent to the Lester Chinese
Hospital for treatment.
A search of the body was made by
detectives, but no paper or other means of identification
were found. The name of the deceased has not yet
been ascertained.

P. T. O.

《国民新闻》、《新闻报》、《申报》、《中美日报》：

徐樑棟博士遭绑架案

7月1日上午10时35分，大漢化學藥廠经理徐樑棟博士（Dr. Zee Liang-tung），该厂位于福格森路18号，当其驾驶私人汽车（牌照号码7340）前往延平路某址出诊途中，在胶州路国际殡仪馆附近被四名男子拦截。其中两人负责监视徐博士，另外两人则持枪胁迫司机蔡安士（Tsai An-s）下车。由于汽车引擎突然发生故障，暴徒将徐博士强行带入一辆等候中的汽车（牌照号码17740）。该车系暴徒于6月30日晚8时从祥泰車行（Ziang Tai Garage）租用，当时他们谎称需要用车前往国际殡仪馆附近，以便将一名病人送往医生诊所。
徐博士家属及司机已向静安寺巡捕房报案，调查工作已展开。
另有报告称，昨日中午12时20分左右，该汽车在霞飞路耶茨路以西路段被发现。巡捕房已通知车行将车移走。

《国民新闻》、《中美日报》、《申报》、《新闻报》：

江西路一不明身份男子遭暗杀

昨晚9时50分，一名年约三十岁、身穿长衫的男子，在江西路235号美雅（Mei Ya）女鞋店门前行走时，被一名身穿短上衣的男子从背后开枪击中，当场身亡。枪手成功逃脱。尸体随后被移至停尸房。
王金氏（Wong Chin-sze），43岁，宁波人，居住于汕头路大東（Dah Tung）麻袋店，当时正乘坐人力车由南向北行驶，右腿被流弹击伤。她被送往莱斯特华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital）接受治疗。
侦探对尸体进行了搜查，但未发现任何证件或其他身份证明文件。死者姓名尚未查明。

P. T. O.

PROGRAMME FOR WAR
ANNIVERSARY

Japanese Households To
Hoist National Flag
Every Morning

The programme for the observ-
ance during the week starting to-
morrow and ending July 7 of the
fourth anniversary of the Sino-
Japanese hostilities was drawn up
at a meeting held Saturday at the
Nippon Club by Japanese military
and other representatives, local
Japanese language newspapers re-
ported yesterday.

Each morning throughout the
week every Japanese household will
hoist the Rising Sun flag. The
Shanghai Broadcasting Station will
also arrange suitable programmes
while all theatres will feature news
reels of the hostilities.

On July 7, all Shanghai Japan-
ese will observe a one minute
silence at 11.50 o'clock in the morn-
ing, while the Shanghai Shrine will
hold ceremonies featuring the
reading of the Imperial Rescript
granted on the first anniversary of
the hostilities.

战事周年纪念活动安排

日本家庭须每日晨间悬挂国旗

据上海日文报纸昨日报道，为纪念中日敌对行动爆发四周年，自明日起为期一周（至7月7日止）的纪念活动安排，已于周六在日本俱乐部召开的会议上由日本军方及其他代表制定。

在该周期间，每个日本家庭每日早晨均须悬挂旭日旗。上海广播电台亦将安排适宜的节目，同时所有剧院将放映有关敌对行动的新闻片。

7月7日上午11时50分，全体在沪日本人将进行一分钟默哀；与此同时，上海神社将举行仪式，宣读在敌对行动一周年之际颁布的敕语。

Chinese Youth arrested in possession of
Patriotic pamphlets.

At 11.a.m. 6/7/41, F.P.S. 708aeda and C..C. 1174,
on plain clothes duty, brought to the station one Sung
Tsoong zung (孙忠仁), 18, Shanghai, s/student of the
Koh Chiang (国強) Middle School, 653 Avenue Road,
residing at house No. 22, Lane 215 Myburgh Road, in the
home of his uncle LOO Tsung Fong (陸振芳), a native
doctor.

The accused was arrested by the above officers at
10.30p.m. even date at the corner of Avenue and Seymour
Roads, in possession of a quantity of Patriotic pamphlets,
which read as follows:-
(1) Commemorate the 7th. of July and drive the
enemy away!
(2) Resist to t he end and exterminate all the
traitors!
(3) Support Generalissimo Chiang and carry out
resistance to t he end.

Questioned by detectives the accused said that the
pamphlets had been given to him by his former school-mate
Yoong Zung Zung (荣章诚) who had brought the same on
4/7/41 to the Koh Chiang Middle School and requested the
accused to distribute them on the evening of 6/7/41.
